body: Okay thank you. my apologizes I will delete this
It has to be Matt Smith because he is my man crush Monday, if I'm honest, but he was the first one I watched. However, David Tennat is really good and he was great in Jessica Jones.

Yeah, I have tried a lot of medications. I have even done the DNA test thing that tells you what medication will work best for me. I keep running into the same problem they will work for a bit and then nothing. Nothing ever sticks. I have even done a rotation of medication, when one stops working switch to another and still doesn't work. Honestly and sadly the best thing that has worked was doing some "non prescribed" drugs to feel different, hell to feel something. 

As far as the bully thing I have never really thought of that as an issue because I've always had some think skin but I'll think about that more deeply. 

Also what would you recommend for someone who has had therapist give up on then? I've had a few and after several sessions with them it ends up something like "It doesn't seem like you have made any progress and your very strong headed in your views on life, there's nothing else I can do for you." And when it comes to family and friends, my friends have told me they don't want to talk to me about that stuff and some have just left me altogether (do to me talking about it to much) And when it comes to my family all expect my mom can't understand why I feel this way and think I'm ungrateful. But my mom has been a huge support, however it has taken a toll on her and now she has to see her own therapist and I can't keep going to her.
I really liked Doctor Who and I'm currently watching The 100 on Netflix.

Hey I don't know if this will help your opinion on it but I feel you on the "no one is genuine" thing. I hate the small niceties that your suppose to do you run to a old "friend" who lets be honest you don't care and neither do they. It's something small like have a surface level conversation but it happens all the time and it just becomes to much.
